1 Scope
This policy applies to AeroNova operated flights departing Dubai. A marketing carrier or codeshare partner
may apply its own allowance; the booking confirmation controls if it explicitly names an operating carrier
other than AeroNova.
2 Checked baggage
Economy Saver and Economy Flex each include one checked bag of up to 20 kg. Business includes up to 35
kg total in no more than two bags. No single bag may exceed 32 kg.
3 Cabin baggage

3 Cabin baggage
Economy passengers may bring one cabin bag weighing up to 7 kg. Business passengers may bring two
cabin bags weighing up to 14 kg combined. Each cabin bag must fit within 55 x 38 x 22 cm.
4 Excess baggage
Prepaid excess baggage costs AED 45 per kg on Dubai to London services and AED 30 per kg on Dubai to
Mumbai services. Airport rates can differ. The maximum permitted weight remains subject to aircraft and
safety restrictions.
5 Historical use
These rules apply only to journeys departing between 1 January and 31 December 2025. They were
replaced on 1 January 2026; use the 2026 policy for later departures.

# A simple guide to travelling light

Pack one cabin bag up to 7 kg in Economy. Both Economy Saver and Flex include 20 kg checked baggage. This article described the 2025 rules and has not been updated for later journeys.
